blocks.content: A beautiful story from the Panchatantra! Three fishes lived in a lake: Anagatavidhata (Proactive), Pratyutpannamati (Quick-thinker), and Yadbhavishya (Fatalist). Guess who survives when the fishermen arrive?

blocks.title: Passage 1: The Three Fishes
blocks.content:
कस्मिंश्चिज्जलाशये अनागतविधाता प्रत्युत्पन्नमतिर्यद्भविष्यश्चेति त्रयो मत्स्याः वसन्ति स्म।
`` `(In a certain lake lived three fishes: Anagatavidhata, Pratyutpannamati, and Yadbhavishya. / किसी जलाशय में अनागतविधाता, प्रत्युत्पन्नमति और यद्भविष्य नामक तीन मछलियां रहती थीं।)` ``
💡 **Teacher Tip:** Notice how the translation in the backticks helps you pronounce and understand the exact English meaning of the classic text!
📝 **Board Exam Tip:** Always memorize the name of the poet/author. 1-mark questions frequently ask 'Who wrote this poem?'
